# Support

This is a community-maintained personal dotfiles project and support is provided
on a best-effort basis.

- Use the bug report form for reproducible installer failures.
- Use the feature request form for improvements and new platform support.
- Check the [installation documentation](../README.md) before opening an issue.

When requesting help, include the operating system, architecture, shell,
package manager, command used, and relevant error output. Redact credentials,
hostnames, IP addresses, usernames, and private paths.

For security vulnerabilities, follow the [security policy](SECURITY.md) instead
of opening a public support request.
